categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Carries the Utils/log/libs label and modifies the shared subprocess library implementation.
categories.rationale: Fixes a memory leak in Windows subprocess execution where `Popen::execute_process()` allocated a command line buffer with `new[]` without freeing it. The leak affects Windows nodes invoking external signers, but the leaked buffer is small and occurs on infrequent process invocations.
